description: This file contains prototype definitions for internal functions of the Slap Bmc2 Input Object in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane (SLAP). It declares functions related to resetting and reading data from the object, used internally within the system.

methods.name: SlapBmc2InoReset
methods.description: Resets the state of the Slap Bmc2 Input Object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2InoRead
methods.description: Reads data from the Slap Bmc2 Input Object.

methods.name: SlapBmc2InoRead2
methods.description: Reads data with additional parameters such as default value, size fixed, mask input, and width from the Slap Bmc2 Input Object.
